from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
root=Path('/tmp/cosmictiger_step5')
cpus=[int(c) for c in os.environ['CT_STEP5_CPUS'].split(',')] if 'CT_STEP5_CPUS' in os.environ else sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]
os.sched_setaffinity(0,cpus)
name=sys.argv[1]; args=sys.argv[2:]
env=dict(os.environ,CCACHE_DISABLE='1',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1')
(root/f'{name}.command.json').write_text(json.dumps({'args':args,'affinity':cpus},indent=2)+'\n')
start=time.monotonic()
with (root/f'{name}.log').open('w') as log:
 result=subprocess.run(args,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,timeout=3600)
print(name, 'exit',result.returncode,'seconds',round(time.monotonic()-start,2),flush=True)
print((root/f'{name}.log').read_text()[-5000:],flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)

from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json,shlex,subprocess
root=Path('/tmp/cosmictiger_step5')
repo=Path('/home/dmarce1/workspace/cosmictiger')
entry=next(c for c in json.loads((repo/'build/pmmm_only_cpu/compile_commands.json').read_text()) if c['file'].endswith('/tests/gravity/basis_conversion.cpp'))
base=shlex.split(entry['command'])
base.remove('-c')
o=base.index('-o'); del base[o:o+2]
def run(order):
 args=[]
 for arg in base:
  for key in ('BASIS_CONVERSION_TEST_ORDER','FMM_MIN_ORDER','FMM_MAX_ORDER','ORDER'):
   if arg.startswith('-D'+key+'='): arg=f'-D{key}={order}'
  args.append(arg)
 exe=root/f'conversion_{order}'
 with (root/f'conversion_{order}.log').open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run(args+['-o',str(exe)],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  subprocess.run([str(exe)],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 print((root/f'conversion_{order}.log').read_text().strip(),flush=True)
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 list(pool.map(run,range(3,10)))

from pathlib import Path
import difflib,json,shlex,subprocess
repo=Path('/home/dmarce1/workspace/cosmictiger'); root=Path('/tmp/cosmictiger_step5'); build=repo/'build/pmmm_only_cpu'
commands=json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text())
def compile_file(original,source,output):
 entry=next(c for c in commands if c['file'].endswith(original))
 args=shlex.split(entry['command']); args[args.index('-o')+1]=str(output)
 args=[str(source) if a==entry['file'] else a for a in args]
 args+=['-iquote',str(repo/'src/gravity/fmm')]
 with (root/(output.stem+'.log')).open('w') as log: subprocess.run(args,cwd=build,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 print('compiled',output.name,flush=True)
profile=root/'profile.o'; compile_file('/tests/gravity/pmmm.cpp',repo/'tests/gravity/pmmm_profile.cpp',profile)
double=(root/'part4_cell_schedule.cpp').read_text()
a=double.index('                hpx::scoped_annotation farWork(')
b=double.index('\n            }\n            if (compact != fields.particleIndices.size())',a)
direct=double[:a]+'                for (; compact < fields.particleIndices.size() && fields.particleIndices[compact] < cell.end; ++compact) {\n                    auto const index = fields.particleIndices[compact];\n                    if (index < cell.begin) {\n                        throw std::runtime_error("PMMM batch output lost its sink mapping");\n                    }\n                    std::array<double, 4> field{};\n                    auto const value = particle(index, center, flops);\n                    flops += evaluate(cache.order, field, coefficients.data(), localTrace, value.offset, h);\n                    field[0] += fields.potential[compact];\n                    for (int dim = 0; dim < kDimensions; ++dim) {\n                        field[dim+1] += fields.acceleration[dim][compact];\n                    }\n                    flops += 8;\n                    consumeField(index, field, result, flops, kickFlops);\n                }'+double[b:]
current=(repo/'src/gravity/fmm/cell_schedule.cpp').read_text()
for name,source in [('double',double),('source_only',direct)]:
 path=root/f'profile_{name}_cell_schedule.cpp';path.write_text(source)
 patch=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(current.splitlines(True),source.splitlines(True),fromfile='a/src/gravity/fmm/cell_schedule.cpp',tofile='b/src/gravity/fmm/cell_schedule.cpp'))
 (repo/'docs'/f'spherical_fmm_profile_{name}.patch').write_text(patch)
 compile_file('/src/gravity/fmm/cell_schedule.cpp',path,root/f'{name}_schedule.o')
lines=subprocess.check_output(['ninja','-t','commands','cosmictiger'],cwd=build,text=True).splitlines()
line=next(l for l in reversed(lines) if ' -o cosmictiger ' in l)
args=shlex.split(line)
if args[:2]==[':','&&']:args=args[2:]
if args[-2:]==['&&',':']:args=args[:-2]
assert '&&' not in args
for name in ('source_only','double','float'):
 launch=list(args); launch[launch.index('-o')+1]=str(root/f'profile_{name}')
 if name!='float':
  matches=[i for i,a in enumerate(launch) if a.endswith('src/gravity/fmm/cell_schedule.cpp.o')]
  assert len(matches)==1; launch[matches[0]]=str(root/f'{name}_schedule.o')
 launch+=[str(profile),'-Wl,--wrap=_Z8pmmmTestv']
 (root/f'profile_{name}.link.json').write_text(json.dumps(launch))
 with (root/f'profile_{name}.link.log').open('w') as log: subprocess.run(launch,cwd=build,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 print('linked',name,flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,time,json
root=Path('/tmp/cosmictiger_step5')
repo=Path('/home/dmarce1/workspace/cosmictiger')
exe=repo/'build/spherical_step5_fixed64/cosmictiger'
rows=[]
for order in range(3,10):
 for near in ('fmm','pp'):
  if any(r['order']==order and r['near']==near for r in rows): continue
  name=f'fixed64_corrected_q{order}_{near}'
  work=root/name;work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  args=[str(exe),'--run.test=pmmm','--run.darkMatterParticleCount=512','--run.gasParticleCount=0','--gravity.meshSize=8','--hydro.enabled=false','--gravity.cuda=false','--drift.cuda=false',f'--gravity.expansionDegree={order-1}',f'--gravity.method.near={near}','--run.timeIntegrator=traditional','--hpx:threads=2','--hpx:bind=none']
  (work/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(args))
  start=time.monotonic()
  with (work/'run.log').open('w') as log:
   result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=work,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=300)
  rows.append({'order':order,'near':near,'exit_code':result.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start})
  (root/'matrix_fixed64_corrected.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
  print(name, result.returncode, round(rows[-1]['seconds'],2),flush=True)
  if result.returncode:
   print((work/'run.log').read_text()[-5000:],flush=True)
   raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
